bio.text: Aber Kawas won the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026 for New York's 12th State Senate District in Queens, defeating Assembly Member Steven Raga, according to unofficial results.
The seat is open because Sen. Michael Gianaris is not running for re-election.
City & State described her in February 2026 as a Palestinian American organizer with the Democratic Socialists of America.

sources.title: Kawas, Gonzalez-Rojas, Addabbo among winners in Queens state Senate primary races
DSA, WFP and Make the Road likely to back Kawas for Gianaris' state Senate seat
